beats.summary: The Scranton branch is being closed by the company.

evidence.snippet: Jan: I am here to tell you that we are closing the Scranton branch.

beats.summary: Michael reacts strongly to the news, expressing disbelief and frustration.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Oh… Oh, my god. Oh, my god! I don't really get it 'cause we're not doing that bad and our numbers are gonna come up.
